result.topic_en: This two-page spread (pp. 166–167) finishes the solution that turns the alternating series s = x/α − x²/(αβ) + … into a continued fraction for x/s and states it as Theorem VIII; it then substitutes x/y for x and specializes to α=1, β=2, γ=3, … to get a continued fraction for x/(1 − e^{−x/y}).
result.transcription:
166
Solutio.
§. 46. Statuamus vt hactenus
$t = \frac{x}{\beta} - \frac{xx}{\beta\gamma} + \frac{x^3}{\beta\gamma\delta} - \frac{x^4}{\beta\gamma\delta\varepsilon} + \text{etc.}$ et
$u = \frac{x}{\gamma} - \frac{xx}{\gamma\delta} + \frac{x^3}{\gamma\delta\varepsilon} - \frac{x^4}{\gamma\delta\varepsilon\zeta} + \text{etc.}$
ita vt sit $s = \frac{x - tx}{\alpha}$, vnde fit $\frac{x}{s} = \frac{\alpha}{1-t} = \alpha + \frac{\alpha t}{1-t}$. Est vero
$\frac{\alpha t}{1-t} = \frac{\alpha}{\frac{1}{t} - 1} = \frac{\alpha x}{-x + \frac{x}{t}}$,
sicque erit
$\frac{x}{s} = \alpha + \frac{\alpha x}{-x + \frac{x}{t}}$.
Simili igitur modo reperietur
$\frac{x}{t} = \beta + \frac{\beta x}{-x + \frac{x}{u}}, \quad \frac{x}{u} = \gamma + \frac{\gamma x}{-x + \frac{x}{v}}$, etc.
Quodsi ergo hi valores continuo in praecedentibus substituantur, obtinebitur sequens fractio continua:
$\frac{x}{s} = \alpha + \cfrac{\alpha x}{\beta - x + \cfrac{\beta x}{\gamma - x + \cfrac{\gamma x}{\delta - x + \text{etc.}}}}$
hincque nascitur
Theorema VIII.
§. 47. Si proposita fuerit huiusmodi series infinita:

$s = \frac{x}{\alpha} - \frac{xx}{\alpha\beta} + \frac{x^3}{\alpha\beta\gamma} - \frac{x^4}{\alpha\beta\gamma\delta} + \text{etc.}$
inde formabitur sequens fractio continua:
$\frac{x}{s} = \alpha + \cfrac{\alpha x}{\beta - x + \cfrac{\beta x}{\gamma - x + \cfrac{\gamma x}{\delta - x + \text{etc.}}}}$
§. 48. Quod si hic loco $x$ scribamus $\frac{x}{y}$, vt habeamus hanc seriem:
$s = \frac{x}{\alpha y} - \frac{xx}{\alpha\beta yy} + \frac{x^3}{\alpha\beta\gamma y^3} - \frac{x^4}{\alpha\beta\gamma\delta y^4} + \text{etc.}$
hinc nascetur sequens fractio continua:
$\frac{x}{s} = \alpha y + \cfrac{\alpha x y}{\beta y - x + \cfrac{\beta x y}{\gamma y - x + \cfrac{\gamma x y}{\delta y - x + \text{etc.}}}}$
§. 49. Sumamus $\alpha = 1$, $\beta = 2$, $\gamma = 3$, $\delta = 4$ etc. vt sit
$s = \frac{x}{y} - \frac{xx}{1\cdot 2 yy} + \frac{x^3}{1\cdot 2\cdot 3 y^3} - \frac{x^4}{1\cdot 2\cdot 3\cdot 4 y^4} + \text{etc.}$
vbi igitur est $s = 1 - e^{\frac{-x}{y}}$, hincque formabitur ista fractio continua:
$\frac{x}{1 - e^{\frac{-x}{y}}} = y + \cfrac{xy}{2y - x + \cfrac{2xy}{3y - x + \cfrac{3xy}{4y - x + \text{etc.}}}}$

items.english: Theorem VIII, §47: If an infinite series of this kind has been proposed, s = x/α − x²/(αβ) + x³/(αβγ) − …, then the following continued fraction will be formed: x/s = α + αx/(β − x + βx/(γ − x + …)).

items.quote: vbi igitur est $s = 1 - e^{\frac{-x}{y}}$, hincque formabitur ista fractio continua:
items.english: Here therefore s = 1 − e^{−x/y}, and hence this continued fraction will be formed: x/(1 − e^{−x/y}) = y + xy/(2y − x + 2xy/(3y − x + …)).
